cards.name: Dialga
cards.description: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.description: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.description: It feeds on eggs stolen from nests. Its sharply hooked claws rip vulnerable spots on prey.

cards.name: Starly
cards.description: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

cards.name: Stunky
cards.description: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

cards.name: Turtwig
cards.description: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

cards.name: Wurmple
cards.description: It loves to eat leaves. If it is attacked by a STARLY, it will defend itself with its spiked rear.

cards.name: Palkia
cards.description: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

cards.name: Rhyperior
cards.description: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. Geodude are shot at rare times.

cards.name: Roserade
cards.description: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

cards.name: Shiftry
cards.description: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.

cards.name: Skuntank
cards.description: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.

cards.name: Staraptor
cards.description: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.

cards.name: Torterra
cards.description: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

cards.name: Azumarill
cards.description: It lives in rivers and lakes. In water, its coloring and patterns trick the vision of foes.

cards.name: Beautifly
cards.description: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey's fluids.

cards.name: Dusknoir
cards.description: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.

cards.name: Bibarel
cards.description: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

cards.name: Carnivine
cards.description: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.description: Rarely seen by people, it is said to be drawn by the full moon to play at deserted lakes.

cards.name: Drapion
cards.description: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

cards.name: Drifblim
cards.description: It's drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.

cards.name: Dustox
cards.description: A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.

cards.name: Floatzel
cards.description: It floats using its well-developed floatation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

cards.name: Gengar
cards.description: It hides in shadows. It is said that if Gengar is hiding, it cools that area by nearly 10 degrees F.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.description: It gathers in forests to search for tree sap, its favorite food. It's strong enough to hurl foes.

cards.name: Hippowdon
cards.description: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.

cards.name: Electivire
cards.description: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

cards.name: Lopunny
cards.description: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.

cards.name: Machamp
cards.description: It punches with its four arms at blinding speed. It can launch 1,000 punches in two seconds.

cards.name: Medicham
cards.description: Through yoga training, it has honed its sixth sense. Its movements are elegant.

cards.name: Munchlax
cards.description: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.

cards.name: Noctowl
cards.description: Its eyes are special. They can pick out objects as long as there is the tiniest amount of light.

cards.name: Pachirisu
cards.description: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

cards.name: Purugly
cards.description: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon's nest and claims it as its own.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.description: Its stomach can digest any kind of food, even if it happens to be moldy or rotten.

cards.name: Steelix
cards.description: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

cards.name: Vespiquen
cards.description: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by COMBEE.

cards.name: Empoleon
cards.description: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.description: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

cards.name: Wobbuffet
cards.description: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.

cards.name: Wynaut
cards.description: It grows strong by pushing up against others en masse. It loves eating sweet fruit.

cards.name: Budew
cards.description: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.

cards.name: Cascoon
cards.description: It is hot inside its cocoon. All the cells in its body create the energy for it to evolve.

cards.name: Cherrim
cards.description: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.description: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

cards.name: Dusclops
cards.description: Its body is hollow. It is said that those who look into its body are sucked into the void.

cards.name: Elekid
cards.description: It generates electricity by whirling its arms. However, it can't store the energy it makes.

cards.name: Grotle
cards.description: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.

cards.name: Infernape
cards.description: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.description: It can slip through any obstacle. It lurks inside walls to keep an eye on its foes.

cards.name: Hippopotas
cards.description: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.description: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.

cards.name: Machoke
cards.description: MACHOKE's boundless power is very dangerous, so it wears a belt that suppresses its energy.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.description: It is actually three MAGNEMITE linked by magnetism. A group can set off a magnetic storm.

cards.name: Mantyke
cards.description: A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.

cards.name: Monferno
cards.description: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.

cards.name: Nuzleaf
cards.description: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.

cards.name: Prinplup
cards.description: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.

cards.name: Rapidash
cards.description: It gallops at nearly 150 mph. With its mane blazing ferociously, it races as if it were an arrow.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.description: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

cards.name: Rhydon
cards.description: Its brain developed after it stood up on its hind legs. Its drill horn bores tunnels through solid rock.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.description: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

cards.name: Seaking
cards.description: It makes its nest by hollowing out boulders in streams with its horn. It defends its eggs with its life.

cards.name: Silcoon
cards.description: It anchors itself by wrapping twigs with the silk from its body. It motionlessly awaits evolution.

cards.name: Staravia
cards.description: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.

cards.name: Unown A
cards.description: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Unown B
cards.description: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Unown C
cards.description: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Unown D
cards.description: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Azurill
cards.description: A Pokémon that lives by water. It moves quickly on land by bouncing on its big tail.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.description: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.

cards.name: Bidoof
cards.description: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

cards.name: Bonsly
cards.description: It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body's fluid levels by eliminating excess.

cards.name: Buizel
cards.description: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.

cards.name: Buneary
cards.description: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.

cards.name: Chatot
cards.description: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

cards.name: Cherubi
cards.description: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.

cards.name: Chimchar
cards.description: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.description: Thought to live with others on quiet mountains, it is popular for its adorable nature.

cards.name: Cleffa
cards.description: Its silhouette is like a star. It is believed to arrive riding on shooting stars.

cards.name: Combee
cards.description: A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to VESPIQUEN.

cards.name: Magnezone
cards.description: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.

cards.name: Duskull
cards.description: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.description: Half of all blackouts occur when this Pokémon appears at power plants and eats electricity.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.description: This Pokémon's body is 95% made up of gases, which are blown away by strong gusts of wind.

cards.name: Glameow
cards.description: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness if very popular among some.

cards.name: Goldeen
cards.description: It swims elegantly by flittering its tail as if it were a dress. It has the look of a queen.

cards.name: Hoothoot
cards.description: It always stands on one foot. Even when attacked, it does not brace itself using both feet.

cards.name: Machop
cards.description: It hefts a GRAVELER repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.description: The units at its sides generate electromagnetic waves that keep it airborne. It feeds on electricity.

cards.name: Marill
cards.description: Using its tail as a float, it dives underwater. It likes eating plants that grow on river bottoms.

cards.name: Meditite
cards.description: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

cards.name: Manaphy
cards.description: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

cards.name: Mime Jr.
cards.description: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.description: It loves to sneak up on people late at night, then startle them with its shrieklike cry.

cards.name: Onix
cards.description: When it travels underground, it causes rumbling and tremors. It can move at 50 mph.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.description: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

cards.name: Ponyta
cards.description: About an hour after birth, its fiery mane and tail grow out, giving it an impressive appearance.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.description: Its body is clad in a thick hide, and its tackles topple buildings. Unfortunately, it is not smart.

cards.name: Roselia
cards.description: ROSELIA raised on clean drinking water are known to grow vividly colored flowers.

cards.name: Seedot
cards.description: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.description: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

cards.name: Skorupi
cards.description: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.
